name: Drowned Domain
description: Pull the hostile mob you are directly looking at into a separate island dimension for 40 seconds. It remains persistent and permanently aggressive toward you for the entire domain. You begin inside a large two-block-deep lagoon while the target starts deep on the raised sandy crescent. After five seconds, fast cannonballs scatter around it every half-second; their four-block blast volume is outlined by smoke. Damage is 55% of your current attack damage, plus 1.5 per completed 10% Curse. You gain 50% movement speed, powerful swimming, Regeneration II and 50% lifesteal while inside. There is no cooldown in the testing build.
